title: adapter manifest
description: What an adapter declares about itself: the runtime it translates to, the runtime versions and source schema versions it supports, the source kinds it renders and the files it writes.
$comment: A range is one or more comma separated comparators (>=, >, <=, <, ==) over dotted numbers, or *. supports is a hard range: a runtime version outside it is unsupported. tested, when present, is the newest runtime version the adapter was verified against; a version above it but inside supports is outdated.

files_written.description: Paths the adapter writes, relative to the runtime's target directory. A trailing /** claims a whole directory.

module.description: The Python module that renders the runtime, for a bundled adapter.

source.description: Where a registered manifest was read from.
